patch_description:
Evaluate GPUs by their KVPR after placing a model rather than by their current KVPR, preventing greedy assignments from overlooking the pressure induced by the new model.

Then add a bounded local-search refinement phase. It accepts only strict lexicographic improvements to the complete sorted GPU-pressure vector, so it minimizes the maximum KVPR first and improves secondary bottlenecks without regressing worse GPUs. The neighborhood includes moves, swaps, one-for-two exchanges, and the reverse pair-for-one exchanges. The reverse exchange is important for memory-constrained placements: two smaller bottleneck models can be consolidated onto another GPU while a larger model is moved back, enabling improvements unreachable by one-for-two exchanges alone. Every candidate explicitly validates post-exchange GPU memory.
